newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian UES leaps 12.5 pct to new high.
newsitem.headline: Russian UES leaps 12.5 pct to new high.

text.p: Russian national power utility UES rose sharply on the Russian Trading System on Wednesday, in the last few hours of trading before a four-day market holiday starts on Thursday.
Market bellwether UES surged 12.5 percent to $0.2679 at 1140 GMT from $0.2380 on Tuesday on a turnover of $7.2 million.

UES, Russia's largest company by sales, released 1996 figures on Tuesday showing consolidated profit, including total sales and profits from UES and its holdings based proportionally on UES's equity stakes at 11 trillion roubles.

But traders said earlier the results were in line with expectations and said Western investors, encouraged by market-friendly inflation figures, were building up positions ahead of the market holidays May 1-4 and 9-11.
